name: Put.io sign-in
description: Signs a Put.io account in through Put.io's own authorization endpoint.

codes.putio_oauth.bad_reply: Put.io sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.putio_oauth.code_expired: The sign-in expired before it was finished. Start it again.
codes.putio_oauth.consent_denied: The sign-in was not granted at Put.io.
codes.putio_oauth.flow_unsupported: Put.io is signed in through the browser, not with a device code.
codes.putio_oauth.no_entropy: The sign-in could not be started because the application had no randomness for it. Try again.
codes.putio_oauth.refresh_refused: Put.io no longer accepts the stored sign-in. Sign in again.
